allot.subject: Shareholders meeting
allot.text: We hereby inform you that an Extra-Ordinary General Meeting of the Company is proposed to be held on Monday, 14th July, 2025 at 02:30 PM (IST) through Video Conferencing ( VC ) / Other Audio Visual Means ( OAVM ) facility to transact the following special business(es):S.N. Businesses1. Increase in authorised share capital of the Company from Rs. 48.50 Crores to Rs. 111.00 Crores2. Issue of 1,50,00,000 Equity Shares on Preferential Basis3.
